stepExplanation:
Step 1 - Parallel combination (6 Ω and 12 Ω):
$$R_p = \frac{R_1 \times R_2}{R_1 + R_2} = \frac{6 \times 12}{6 + 12} = \frac{72}{18} = 4 \text{ Ω}$$

Step 2 - Series combination (4 Ω parallel result with 4 Ω):
$$R_{total} = R_p + R_3 = 4 + 4 = 8 \text{ Ω}$$
stepBody: First find the parallel resistance of 6 Ω and 12 Ω, then add the 4 Ω in series. Give your answer in ohms.
